reviews.text: I had a great experience with Kyra! She really helped build my puppy’s confidence in a gentle and positive way. I learned a lot, especially the basics of training and how to communicate clearly and consistently.

I can’t recommend Kyra enough! She worked wonders with our puppy and, just as importantly, taught me how to keep up the training between sessions. Beyond the basics, she went above and beyond by pointing us toward the best chews, food, and vets to set our pup up for a happy and healthy life.

Kyra was a huge help in training our puppy, Saka.she is super knowledgeable about dogs and had so many useful tips and suggestions. She was great at bringing my kids into the training sessions and teaching them how to help look after the puppy.
Kyra was wonderful to work with! We would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a dog trainer or behaviourist. She was very helpful and our dog absolutely loved her.

Kyra was amazing with my new pup we had a few weeks of training and she taught me so much and helped my little nervous pup be more confident. She also felt instantly at ease with her and for a shy dog who was scared of everything that was a great sign too.

Kyra was a great help with my high-energy Australian Shepherd Ellie. She provided tools and techniques we could use to help her settle into her new home and country (moved from Aus to UK). We're already seeing improvements!

Kyra was a great help teaching us the essentials for our 14 week old puppy. Her use of positive reinforcement has made our pup into a little angel! Kyra met us at our house for basic training before we did some outside work in the local parks. Our puppy was nervous around dogs at first but now she's much more confident and looking to play with friendly dogs. I would really recommend Kyra especially if you have a puppy to get on the right path as soon as possible (and to mitigate any problems arising in future!)

We really enjoyed working with Kyra to train our new puppy. She was knowledgable, polite and punctual. She gave us loads of ideas for how to train our puppy in novel and engaging ways, and helped us on the path to transitioning from toileting indoors to outdoors (we live in a central London apartment). Would recommend starting as early as possible to put your puppy on the road to success and happiness!

Thank you so much Kyra for all your advice pre and post puppy! We felt more confident starting the process and we got even more confident after each session. Little Louie is responding well to all the helpful training tips and we look forward to continuing to work with you!

We couldn’t be happier with the training and support Kyra has provided for our puppy. When we first came to her, he was overly excited, and we struggled to calm him down. While he knew how to sit, he still needed proper potty training and help with following basic commands. Kyra has been incredibly patient and knowledgeable, guiding us through every step.

She’s helped us with socialising him in the park, teaching us the best techniques for recall, and ensuring he remains calm and focused. Her recommendations for chew toys and treats have been a lifesaver—especially since he loves to tear things apart! She’s also given us great advice on managing his diet and even introduced us to a wonderful vet.

Kyra truly cares about both dogs and their owners, tailoring her training to fit our needs. Thanks to her, we now have a much more confident and well-behaved pup. We highly recommend her to anyone looking for an experienced and supportive trainer!

Kyra provided a really comprehensive service, including a written report, and we noticed a change in our dogs behaviour very quickly after using her advice. We have a nervous dog that gets overexcited so the focus of the training was to help calm him and to stop jumping on visitors. We’d work with Kyra again and would recommend her.

We had the pleasure of working with Kyra to help us welcome our Cocker Spaniel puppy, Samba, into our home, and we couldn't be more grateful for her guidance. From day one, she helped us establish the right rules and structure, making sure Samba felt secure and that we, as a family, knew exactly what to do (and what not to do!).

One of our biggest concerns was Samba’s interactions with our children, as she sometimes growled and wasn’t always gentle. Kyra provided invaluable advice on how to manage these situations, setting clear boundaries while ensuring a positive and trusting relationship between Samba and the kids.

Beyond behavior training, she also gave us great tips on nutrition, the right toys and games, and how to foster a strong and balanced bond with our puppy. Her professionalism, patience, and reassurance made all the difference, and we now feel much more confident in raising Samba the right way.

If you're looking for someone knowledgeable, kind, and effective to help with your dog, we highly recommend Kira!

Kyra has been very helpful with my golden retriever puppy Ellie. She has helped with getting Ellie to sleep in her crate and gave a lot of great advise on raising my puppy!

Kyra was amazing help with my new puppy. As a first dog owner she helped me with structuring the first couple weeks home with puppy. She guided me on key things to train and it was a huge help in relieving the stress from all the contradicting things out there online. I highly recommend Kyra!
Kyra was a fantastic help to us training our Lurcher puppy; very knowledgeable, supportive and positive. Even in. the freezing rain on Wormwood Scrubs!
